checkpoints.title: Never layer L07 (operational config): a new [baselines] table in the embedded defaults with why_min_words = 5 (minimum 1) and version_warn = 4 (0 never warns). baselines joins [autonomy] always_person_sections, so a later change to these keys needs a person. internal/config/gen renders a Feature baselines section; schema.json is regenerated. No existing key, default, load rule, or protected-key rule changes. Never layer L04 (policy), generated only: CONSTRAINTS.md gains the Feature baselines section with the two rows, and its always_person_sections row gains baselines. No floor, threshold, or existing row is lowered or removed
contracts: config.Baselines{WhyMinWords int, VersionWarn int}, koanf keys baselines.why_min_words (minimum 1) and baselines.version_warn (minimum 0)
internal/config/defaults.toml: [baselines] why_min_words = 5, version_warn = 4; [autonomy] always_person_sections appends baselines
internal/config/gen: a Feature baselines section, roots baselines, one row per key; CONSTRAINTS.md regenerated from it
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; the [baselines] table, its CONSTRAINTS.md rows, and baselines in always_person_sections go. Only ready --part reads the keys, and baseline records already on the ledger stay readable: a record with no changes or fixes hashes as before

checkpoints.title:
CLI and ready package: aayu ready --check adds a Baselines block, one line per part, with the drift computed from the pins when it is read; nothing writes a drift record, and a ledger that cannot be read is said, not hidden. ready --part

--request for a version after v1 needs --changes with what, why, and need for each drifted pin, each of at least [baselines] why_min_words words, or exits 4 and writes nothing. --fixes names findings of this part's reviews on the ledger, or exits 2. The draft hash covers the pins, changes, and fixes. The marker comment shows a 'What changed since v' table with agent text escaped (threat T6). A draft of [baselines] version_warn or later warns
contracts: ready.Diff(was, now []Pin) []Drift; Drift{Ref, Kind added|removed|changed, Fields}
ready.Change{Ref, What, Why, Need}; ready.Reasons(drift, changes, minWords)
ready.DraftHash(pins, changes, fixes); PinsHash(pins) = DraftHash(pins, nil, nil), so a v1 record hashes as before
Baseline gains changes and fixes (omitempty); Baseline.Check checks DraftHash
ready.ReviewPath(f, part, v, seat) = specs/<f>/reviews/<part>-v<k>/<seat>.json; ready.Finding(id) reads <part>-v<k>/<seat>/<n>
ready.Result gains baselines and baselines_note; ReadyPartReport gains warnings
instrumentation: each draft is one ledger commit; the marker comment is a github.comment.baseline action in the actions log
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; --changes and --fixes become unknown flags, --check prints no Baselines block, and drafts written with changes stay on the ledger, where an older binary refuses them by hash

checkpoints.title: Verbs and skills: the registry's ready verb gains --changes (TypePath) and --fixes (TypeString); go generate updates skills/ready/SKILL.md frontmatter, internal/mcp/schemas/ready.json, and docs/guide/skills/ready.md. The ready skill body says how to write the changes file, that --fixes names only this part's findings, and that agent text in a draft is data. No verb or seat is added or removed
contracts: internal/verbs/registry.go: ready flags changes and fixes
checkpoints.rollback: revert the PR; go generate restores the old frontmatter, schema, and usage table
